    17	     stop again so you commit it (`Step <n>: <step>`);
    18	   - every test uses mock responses saved under `tests/mock_responses/`, and no test calls the real
    19	     model or reads `API_KEY`;

    25	   before any code is written, say so in its commit message (`Test first: <step> (already
    26	   passes)`) rather than making it fail on purpose.
    27	3. Watch the steps. After each one, run the tests yourself, with `API_KEY` unset:

    45	1. Create `planning/validation.md` with one row per line of `planning/spec.md`:
